# Worked example: decomposition modelled live {#sec-decomposition}

*A companion to the week-eleven lecture on breaking a task into pieces.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
Takes a task made of several functions and models the decision of what the pieces are before any code is written: naming each function, stating its inputs and outputs, and giving one worked example per piece. Pairs with the plan-before-you-prompt note, and produces the stub-and-docstring plan the student then builds against.
:::
